statement: The lagrange.management.v1 HTTP surface fails closed on authority and never reports fabricated state. /management/v1/* routes refuse before any management owner exists or acts when control-plane credentials are unconfigured (typed CONTROL_PLANE_AUTH_UNCONFIGURED) or the presented credentials are wrong; the cluster identity comes only from the established cluster record, reads as unknown when unestablished and refuses identity-bound operations with a typed code, and the genuine identity survives restart and restore; absent runtime health, capacity and topology snapshots read as unknown with a typed reason and never grant operation admission; backup, restore, rolling upgrade and node decommission without their installed physical adapters are refused as capability-unsupported before any effect and can never report SUCCEEDED, with no in-memory or synthetic substitute in production composition. Node-to-node bootstrap/registration route authentication is out of scope (0.5 cluster trust) and is recorded as a finding.

constraints.statement: No development bypass, alias, compatibility path or default that turns a missing credential, identity, snapshot or adapter into success. Every deployment or test path that uses management routes configures credentials explicitly.

Authorization and capability receipts are proven through the BootstrapAPI Fastify server as production composes it, with real HTTP requests, asserting absence of effect through the owner's declared ports.
No full backup/PITR, rolling-upgrade or decommission execution is implemented; node-to-node bootstrap/registration authentication behaviour is unchanged.
